description: A left-to-right system diagram with four groups, no headings above them. On the far LEFT: a rounded browser-window shape titled 'Workflow Studio' containing three side-by-side regions labelled 'Palette', 'Canvas', 'Run panel'. LEFT OF CENTRE: a document card labelled 'Workflow JSON', with one arrow from the browser window to it labelled 'save' and one arrow from it back to the browser labelled 'run'. RIGHT OF CENTRE: a box 'Studio engine' with an arrow from the document card into it, and directly beneath the engine a small cylinder 'Runs and waits' joined to it by a short line. On the far RIGHT, stacked vertically: a box 'Toolbox · the same 15 tools as Ask Rasoi' on top, and below it a box 'Your own Rasoi · Bahi ERP 7.2' in ember tint. One arrow from the Studio engine to the Toolbox box only, and one arrow down from the Toolbox box to the Bahi box. Along the bottom right, under the engine and the toolbox, a thin green bracket with the text 'every write: preview, confirm, idempotency key, the person's own permissions'. The only words in the image are the quoted labels: no column titles, no numbers, no other captions. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A two-panel side-by-side comparison of equal size. LEFT panel, header 'WORKFLOW' in sky blue with a small subtitle 'a path you draw'. Inside it, a single horizontal row of six small rounded boxes joined by straight arrows, left to right: 'Check stock' -> 'Raise PR' -> 'Rohit approves' -> 'Create PO' -> 'Release' -> 'Message Rohit'. The six boxes are in two rows of three if needed to fit (snake layout), arrows clear. Under the chain a thin caption line 'Same steps, same order, every run'. RIGHT panel, header 'AGENT' in sky blue with a small subtitle 'a model picks the path'. In its centre one larger rounded box 'Model'. Around it a ring of six small monospace tags: 'check_stock', 'find_supplier', 'create_purchase_request', 'create_purchase_order', 'release_purchase_order', 'send_message'. A circular arrow loops from 'Model' out to the tags and back, labelled 'choose a tool -> run it -> read the result'. Under it a thin caption line 'The next step is decided at run time'. Both panels are light grey-blue cards #F0F4F9 with identical size and alignment. The only words in the image are the quoted labels. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets; code-like labels in a monospace font.
